text: Not receiving any anti-tumor treatment before surgery, including chemotherapy, embolization, ablation, radiotherapy, and molecular targeted therapy;

text: Able to comply with research plans, follow-up plans, and other protocol requirements;

text: Voluntary participation and signed informed consent.

text: Currently diagnosed with other types of tumors or any cancer history;
